headline: CONFLUENCE — depth-mismatched driver (H1) + genuine out-of-phase deep-clay physics (H3), compounded by temporally poisoned recent truth (H2). Code exonerated.

matrix.note: screen samples 177 m; clay compacts at ~256 m; seasonal head signal ~0. But no clean local replacement (best local only 0.65 at 810-day lag).
pre-2019 genuine field data; 2024+ fully interpolated. Blind era (2019-23) transitional. Recent-era confirmatory is not field-verifiable.

matrix.deciding_metric: lit. 90%-compaction lag / surface rank / co-screened head
matrix.value: 26-488 d lag; rank-1 carrier; no deep piezometer
matrix.note: TKSH/Tuku observed out-of-phase 2004-07 (soil creep, Noordbergum); surface inversion rank-deficient (Phase 0). Deep clay genuinely lags any shallow head.
solver recovers tau=200 exactly from a clean driver; fails only when driver |r| < ~0.58.

reframes_redteam: Red Team 'underdetermined at sparse cadence' is CONFIRMED but sharpened: the network has no piezometer screened in the F3 clay (240-275 m), so the physically correct slow head is simply unmeasured; and the deep clay is intrinsically out-of-phase with the shallow heads that DO exist.
actionable_next_step: F3 reconstruction at TUKU needs a deep (240-275 m) co-screened piezometer or a modelled deep head; with only shallow heads + surface GPS the sub-annual F3 dynamics remain unrecoverable. Trend apportionment + datum-via-visits stays valid.
